about: The commercial catalogue (doc 106): what SecuRAX sells, to whom, at what price, and the screenshot that proves it. Edit this file when a product or price changes, then run python3 tools/screenshots.py (in a clean checkout: it uses sample data only) and python3 tools/features_sync.py; the product site, the docs and the README update from it. Each product lists the features (features.json ids) and commands it is made of; its status light is the weakest of its features', so a page can never claim more than the code proves. Prices are hypotheses to test with design partners (doc 106 section 8), each with the public anchor it was set against. Every product is a core line or a bet (doc 107) and carries kill_if: the dated test that stops it or folds it into another, so no product lives on hope.

products.kill_if: Fewer than 2 paying organisations, or a gateway pilot that blocks real work, by 2027-03-31
products.name: Shield
products.tagline: Use any AI. Keep your data out of it.
products.for: Any organisation whose people use AI tools or build on models
products.what: One gateway in front of every model: prompt-injection and jailbreak rails (multi-part prompts and the system context included), India-aware redaction of Aadhaar, PAN, cards and UPI, data-residency routing, a tool-call guard for agents, per-user AI allowances, a kill switch and a tamper-evident audit trail. Mapped to OWASP LLM and Agentic Top 10, MITRE ATLAS and NIST AI 600-1.
products.price: ₹399 a user a month, 10 users minimum
products.anchor: AI firewalls are quote-only; third-party sites report US$20,000–80,000 a year for one vendor's enterprise plan (unverified)

shot.alt: The gateway refusing a prompt attack and redacting personal data, real output

products.kill_if: Fewer than 3 pilots by 2026-11-21, or no paid customer by 2027-01-31

shot.alt: A sample board pack: readiness, the vital few, recurring duties
